findings.summary: A repeated ExitRequested returns before prevent_exit when recording entries are empty even though a Quit still awaits document ACKs.
findings.method: Runtime discovery reported by root from verify_app; control flow independently confirmed by this fixed-source static read. No runtime reproduction performed by this reviewer.
findings.required_fix: An existing pending Quit must prevent repeated ExitRequested before any empty-recording fast path.

corrects_preliminary_message: Earlier no-new-blocker preliminary message omitted repeated ExitRequested early-return ordering; this record supersedes it.
